note: A synthetic client (Slice 127 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our ledger shows $44,700 owed to our main packaging supplier, but their month-end statement says we owe $52,900.

answers.common.decision: Which entries to post and what to ask the supplier; the controller approves.
answers.common.materials: An invoice for $7,400 is on their statement but not yet entered in our ledger. We sent a payment of $2,600 on the last day of the month that is not on their statement. They issued a credit note for $1,800 that we have not recorded.
answers.accounting-operations.systems: Our accounting system, standard chart of accounts.
answers.accounting-operations.approver: The controller approves all entries and supplier emails.
